objectives.description: Introduction to Marketing: meaning; explanation of basic terms (needs, wants, demands, product, exchange, transactions, markets); brief history of marketing in Nigeria; functions of marketing.
Marketing Concepts: meaning; various marketing concepts (production, product, selling, marketing and societal marketing).
Marketing Mix and Marketing Environment: meaning; elements (4 Ps); marketing environment; factors affecting marketing environment (political, cultural, religious, economic, technological, social).

subStrands.name: Products, Markets, Consumer Behaviour and Organisational Behaviour

objectives.description: Products: meaning; classification (industrial goods, consumer goods, services, primary and secondary products, mineral products — oil and non-oil); distinctions between classes of products.
Markets: meaning; classification — consumer, organisation (industrial, reseller and government).
Consumer and Organisational Behaviour: meaning; influencing factors; decision process in logical order.

subStrands.name: Planning, Research, Pricing, Advertising, Sales Promotion and Merchandising

objectives.description: Marketing Planning and Research: meaning, process and importance; elements of marketing planning; information required; reasons for marketing planning and research; utilisation of feedback.
Pricing: meaning; strategies (haggling, cost-plus, demand and competition); price determinants.
Advertising: definition; functions; media — meaning, types, advantages and disadvantages.
Sales Promotion: meaning and functions; forms — price-off, coupons, salesmen competition, loyalty schemes, premium offers, trade-in-allowance, sampling, training schemes, merchandising incentives.
Merchandising: meaning; elements (packaging, branding and labelling); influencing factors; functions.
Distribution: definition; channels of distribution (definition and types); factors influencing choice of distribution channels; functions of channel members.
Transportation: meaning, mode, choice and importance; documents used in transportation; factors affecting choice of transportation.
Warehousing: meaning, types and functions; activities in the warehouse.

subStrands.name: Market Unions, Facilitators, International Marketing, ICT and Entrepreneurship

objectives.description: Market Unions and Facilitators: market unions (meaning and types); roles of market unions in local markets; market facilitators — meaning, types and roles.
International Marketing: meaning, importance/reasons and methods; influencing factors; guiding rules and regulations.
ICT in Marketing: e-marketing (electronic marketing) — meaning, importance, uses, ethics and abuses.
Entrepreneurship in Marketing: meaning; setting up a marketing business; business plan; marketing of products.
